900.r: feminine plural active participle of H898 (בָּגַד);

904.d: Bigthan or Bigthana, a eunuch of Xerxes
904.r: or בִּגְתָנָא; of similar derivation to H903 (בִּגְתָא);

905.d: properly, separation; by implication, a part of the body, branch of atree, bar forcarrying; figuratively, chief of a city; especially (with prepositional prefix) as an adverb, apart, only, besides
905.k: alone, apart, bar, besides, branch, by self, of each alike, except, only, part, staff, strength.

906.d: flaxen thread or yarn; hence, a linen garment
906.r: perhaps from H909 (בָּדַד) (in the sense of divided fibres);

907.d: a brag or lie; also a liar

912.r: probably a shortened form H5662 (עֹבַדְיָה); servant of Jehovah;

913.d: alloy (because removed by smelting); by analogy, tin

914.d: to divide (in variation senses literally or figuratively, separate, distinguish, differ, select, etc.)
914.k: (make, put) difference, divide (asunder), (make) separate (self, -ation), sever (out), [idiom] utterly.

916.d: something in pieces, i.e. bdellium, a (fragrant) gum (perhaps amber); others a pearl

917.d: Bedan, the name of two Israelites

918.r: a primitive root; to gap open; used only as a denominative from H919 (בֶּדֶק);

919.d: a gap or leak (in a building or a ship)

920.r: probably from H1856 (דָּקַר) with a prepositional prefix; by stabbing, i.e. assassin;

922.d: a vacuity, i.e. (superficially) an undistinguishable ruin
922.r: from an unused root (meaning to be empty);

923.r: from an unused root (probably meaning to glisten);

925.r: from an unused root (meaning to be bright);

926.d: to tremble inwardly (or palpitate), i.e. (figuratively) be (causative, make) (suddenly) alarmed or agitated; by implication to hasten anxiously
926.k: be (make) affrighted (afraid, amazed, dismayed, rash), (be, get, make) haste(-n, -y, -ily), (give) speedy(-ily), thrust out, trouble, vex.

929.d: properly, a dumb beast; especially any large quadruped or animal (often collective)
929.r: from an unused root (probably meaning to be mute);

930.d: a water-ox, i.e. the hippopotamus or Nile-horse
930.r: in form a plural or H929 (בְּהֵמָה), but really a singular of Egyptian derivation;

931.d: the thumb of the hand or great toe of the foot
931.r: from an unused root apparently meaning to be thick;

933.r: from an unused root meaning to be pale;

934.d: a whitish spot on the skin
934.r: feminine active participle of the same as H925 (בָּהִיר);

935.d: to go or come (in a wide variety of applications)
935.k: abide, apply, attain, [idiom] be, befall, [phrase] besiege, bring (forth, in, into, to pass), call, carry, [idiom] certainly, (cause, let, thing for) to come (against, in, out, upon, to pass), depart, [idiom] doubtless again, [phrase] eat, [phrase] employ, (cause to) enter (in, into, -tering, -trance, -try), be fallen, fetch, [phrase] follow, get, give, go (down, in, to war), grant, [phrase] have, [idiom] indeed, (in-) vade, lead, lift (up), mention, pull in, put, resort, run (down), send, set, [idiom] (well) stricken (in age), [idiom] surely, take (in), way.

938.d: Buz, the name of a son of Nahor, and of an Israelite

939.d: something scorned; an object of contempt

940.d: a Buzite or descendant of Buz

945.r: the same as H944 (בּוּל) (in the sense of rain);

948.r: from an unused root (of the same form) meaning to bleach, i.e. (intransitive) be white;

949.r: from the same as H948 (בּוּץ); shining;

950.r: feminine passive participle of an unused root (meaning to be hollow);

951.r: properly, active participle from H1239 (בָּקַר) as denominative from H1241 (בָּקָר);

953.d: a pit hole (especially one used as a cistern or a prison)
953.r: from H952 (בּוּר) (in the sense of H877 (בֹּאר));

954.d: properly, to pale, i.e. by implication to be ashamed; also (by implication) to be disappointed or delayed
954.k: (be, make, bring to, cause, put to, with, a-) shamed(-d), be (put to) confounded(-fusion), become dry, delay, be long.

959.k: despise, disdain, contemn(-ptible), [phrase] think to scorn, vile person.

962.k: catch, gather, (take) for a prey, rob(-ber), spoil, take (away, spoil), [idiom] utterly.

964.r: from H959 (בָּזָה) and H3050 (יָהּ); contempts of Jah;

965.r: from an unused root meaning to lighten;

970.d: properly, selected, i.e. a youth (often collective)
970.r: or בָּחֻר; participle passive of H977 (בָּחַר);

973.k: abhor, get hastily (from the margin for H926 (בָּהַל)).

974.d: to test (especially metals); generally and figuratively, to investigate

975.r: from H974 (בָּחַן) (in the sense of keeping a look-out);

977.d: properly, to try, i.e. (by implication) select
977.k: acceptable, appoint, choose (choice), excellent, join, be rather, require.

978.d: a Bacharumite or inhabitant of Bachurim

979.r: or בְּחוּרוֹת; feminine plural of H970 (בָּחוּר); also (masculine plural) בְּחֻרִים;

980.r: or בַּחוּרִים; masculine plural of H970 (בָּחוּר); young men;

981.d: to babble; hence, to vociferate angrily

982.d: figuratively, to trust, be confident or sure
982.r: a primitive root; properly, to hide for refuge (but not so precipitately as H2620 (חָסָה));
982.k: be bold (confident, secure, sure), careless (one, woman), put confidence, (make to) hope, (put, make to) trust.

983.d: properly, a place of refuge; abstract, safety, both the fact (security) and the feeling (trust); often (adverb with or without preposition) safely
983.k: assurance, boldly, (without) care(-less), confidence, hope, safe(-ly, -ty), secure, surely.

990.d: the belly, especially the womb; also the bosom or body of anything
990.r: from an unused root probably meaning to be hollow;
990.k: belly, body, [phrase] as they be born, [phrase] within, womb.

992.d: (only in plural) a pistachio-nut (from its form)

994.d: oh that!; with leave, or if it please
994.r: perhaps from H1158 (בָּעָה) (in the sense of asking); properly, a request; used only adverbially (always with 'my Lord');

995.d: to separate mentally (or distinguish), i.e.(generally) understand
995.k: attend, consider, be cunning, diligently, direct, discern, eloquent, feel, inform, instruct, have intelligence, know, look well to, mark, perceive, be prudent, regard, (can) skill(-full), teach, think, (cause, make to, get, give, have) understand(-ing), view, (deal) wise(-ly, man).

996.d: between (repeated before each noun, often with other particles); also as a conjunction, either...or
996.r: (sometimes in the plural masculine or feminine); properly, the constructive form of an otherwise unused noun from H995 (בִּין); a distinction; but used only as a preposition,
996.k: among, asunder, at, between (-twixt...and), [phrase] from (the widest), [idiom] in, out of, whether (it be...or), within.

997.d: {between (repeated before each noun, often with other particles); also as a conjunction, either...or}
